name: isi_1p65m
label: ISI 1.65 m Pfund telescope (truck-mounted siderostat + paraboloid)
sources: Hale et al. 2000, ApJ 537, 998 (the Infrared Spatial Interferometer): three 1.65 m Pfund-type telescopes on semi-trailers
PDM series datasheet: free-beam module, 100 um active area (~4 arcsec at the ISI prime focus)
notes: throughput 0.5 = flat siderostat + paraboloid (two aluminium reflections, ~0.8 at 650-900 nm) x atmosphere (~0.85) x relay optics to the free-beam PDM (~0.75); no fibre and no slit loss with the 4 arcsec active area.
The 1.65 m pupil smears binary fringes with periods below ~5 m (Capella at 900 nm: lambda/rho = 3.3 m).
assumptions: throughput (the ISI's optics were built for 11 um; coatings and relay to be confirmed)
